## NHS Performance Outlook

The table below summarises the latest position and our expectation for the next NHS performance release.

> Headline forecast data will appear here once `forecast_summary.csv` is produced by the forecasting pipeline.

**[Download the NHS Performance Outlook →](forecasts/2026-10-07/nhs-performance-outlook-forecast-2026-10-07.pdf)**

### How to read the outlook

**Latest** is the most recently published performance.

**Next forecast** is the central estimate for the next release.

**Forecast range** reflects uncertainty based on historical forecast performance.

**Actual** is filled in once the corresponding NHS data are published.

## About

These are statistical forecasts, not NHS targets. They describe expected performance based on the information available when each forecast was produced.

Forecasts are produced before the corresponding NHS performance data are released, allowing subsequent performance to be compared with the prior expectation.

**Pilot.** The methods, presentation and range of indicators are being tested and may change as the publication develops.
